novel_features.name: Daily quest briefing
novel_features.description: Turn today’s dailies, due to-dos, and character state into one actionable quest queue.
novel_features.rationale: Combines live task and character data into one account-specific briefing instead of exposing another single endpoint.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this before planning the day instead of issuing separate task and profile calls.

novel_features.name: Structured morning quest plan
novel_features.description: Preview a chore batch as Habitica quests and create it only after an explicit apply confirmation.
novel_features.rationale: Safely converts one structured chore plan into multiple real task-create calls with no hidden mutation.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this to turn a prepared chore list into quests while retaining a complete mutation preview.

novel_features.name: Reward runway
novel_features.description: Check whether a reward fits current gold while preserving a chosen reserve for later goals.
novel_features.rationale: Joins real character gold with account-specific custom reward prices.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this before spending gold when a generic purchase request cannot explain the tradeoff.

novel_features.name: Tag workload report
novel_features.description: Compare active, due, overdue, and checklist-blocked work across Habitica tags.
novel_features.rationale: Requires live aggregation across task and tag resources, not tag CRUD alone.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this to rebalance chores by category rather than scanning individual tasks.

novel_features.name: Weekly task health
novel_features.description: Review seven-day overdue, stalled, and completed-task trends from real local snapshots.
novel_features.rationale: Only a timestamped local mirror can compare task state over time without inventing history.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this in weekly review to see whether the Habitica system is improving or accumulating debt.

narrative.headline: Turn chores into quests, check off workouts, and protect your reward budget from the command line.
narrative.value_prop: Habitica CLI covers the official task and game-management API, then layers a preview-first daily workflow on top. Use `today`, `plan chores`, `reward afford`, `tag load`, and `week review` to make account state useful to people and agents without accidental scoring or spending.
narrative.auth_narrative: Set `HABITICA_USER_ID` and `HABITICA_API_TOKEN` from Habitica Settings → API. The CLI sends them only as the official `x-api-user` and `x-api-key` headers and uses its own `x-client` platform identifier; never place either value in a plan file or command line.

quickstart.comment: Check local configuration without sending a mutation.
Start the day with a focused quest queue.
Decide whether a reward fits the remaining gold budget.

troubleshoots.symptom: The API reports missing authentication or client headers.
troubleshoots.fix: Set HABITICA_USER_ID and HABITICA_API_TOKEN, then run habitica-pp-cli doctor --json.
Wait for the API reset window shown in the error, then retry the bounded command.

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI for task and reward workflows in an existing Habitica account, especially when an agent needs structured output and a preview before a mutation. It is suited to a daily quest queue, chore batching, workout/task scoring, and budget-aware rewards.
anti_triggers: Do not use this CLI to infer a user’s health, productivity, or financial condition from Habitica data.
Do not use this CLI to spend gold, score tasks, or change account state without reviewing the dry-run output and explicitly applying it.
Do not use this CLI as a replacement for a human decision about account deletion, subscription, or other irreversible account actions.
